predecessors.name: Karamanli dynasty
predecessors.text: Tripoli and its surroundings, from which Burghul expelled 'Ali ibn Mehmed Karamanli on 30 July 1793

successors.name: Karamanli dynasty
successors.text: Tripoli, regained by Hamet and Yusuf Karamanli on 19 January 1795

ledger.x: 30 July 1793: Tripoli passes from the Karamanli to Burghul, who would 'rule it in the name of the sultan' (Abun-Nasr).

30 September 1794: Burghul occupies Djerba, an island under Hammuda ibn Ali, the Bey of Tunis, who had hesitated to act against Burghul because Burghul claimed the sultan's authority, and acted after the occupation.
19 January 1795: Burghul's hold on Djerba ends with his flight.
19 January 1795: Hamet and Yusuf return to Tripoli 'with the aid of the Bey of Tunis and the rebels' and Burghul flees to Egypt.

wars.name: Tripolitanian civil war
wars.outcome: Karamanli victory: the Karamanli return to Tripoli on 19 January 1795 with the aid of the Bey of Tunis and the rebels; Burghul flees to Egypt.

certainty.note: A city and its hinterland held for eighteen months; no frontier is on the page.
